image_description: A small, slender weasel (likely a stoat or short-tailed weasel) standing on rocky ground with dry grass in the background. The animal has brown fur on its back and head, with white/cream fur on its chest, belly, and face. It is looking directly at the camera. The body is elongated, legs are short, and the tail appears relatively short.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small triangular head with pointed snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, exhibiting a distinct triangular shape tapering to a pointed snout, consistent with mustelid anatomy.
Both eyes are visible, appearing small, dark, and round, positioned correctly on the head.
Ears are visible on top of the head; they are short and have a rounded appearance, matching the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Extremely elongated slender body with remarkably fine, diminutive proportions and lightweight build.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The torso is visibly long and cylindrical relative to its height, demonstrating the characteristic 'noodle-like' flexibility and slenderness of a weasel.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short dense fur in brown dorsally with white or yellow ventral coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows clear bicolored patterning: rich brown on the dorsal side (back/head) and white/cream on the ventral side (chest/belly/face), typical of summer coat stoats/weasels.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Some species turn white in winter (ermine morph).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a conditional seasonal trait. The current image shows a brown/white summer coat, so the 'all-white' ermine morph is not present, but this does not indicate an error.
The transition from head to shoulders shows a distinct, slender neck section, contributing to the overall elongated silhouette.
The front legs are visible and appear very short relative to the body length, supporting the low-slung posture typical of the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short tail relative to body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible extending behind the rear legs. While it has a black tip (characteristic of stoats), its length is proportionally short compared to the long torso.
